title: Salas's 2.5-hour AARO interview

tellings.quote: my case, I gave them a 2 and 1/2 hour talk. I I gave them documents to support what I was saying.

plain: Robert Salas, a former Air Force officer whose case, as the episode puts it, is about a UFO that shut down ten nuclear missiles, says he gave a two and a half hour account to AARO, the Pentagon office set up to look into UFO reports. He tells Michels he also handed over documents to back up what he said. He does not say when the interview took place, and he tells it to show that his case is on the official record.
